{{Top|leg}}
'''F'rod''' was a [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] who purchased a [[PG-5 gunnery droid]] from a military surplus auction, then upgraded it with modern [[SkillWare]], creating a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] which was a better conman than F'rod was himself. The droid was also a capable [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]], and served aboard F'rod's personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Because the droid was purchased at auction, F'rod paid less for the droid&mdash;including its modifications&mdash;than a standard [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]].
